metadata.title: Clicked like a confused spider and somehow caught 1 poor soul? Valorant WTF logic again
metadata.description:
Pressed random buttons like my mouse was on a sugar rush.
Enemy probably uninstalling or questioning life choices.
Did NOT deserve that one but hey, chaos picked me today.
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, this one’s for you.

Tap if your aim’s a glorious mess too!
